findings.finding: Use ages a,b; sweets x,y. From “give 5 sweets” get b+y=10 and a+x=20. So x=20−a, y=10−b. Equality of sums after transfer gives a(15−a)=b(15−b). Equality of products after transfer gives a(20−a)=4b(10−b). Solve integers 1≤a≤15,1≤b≤10. Only solution a=10,b=5. Product=50.

Key: From sum equations: S_A=2S_B and S_A−S_B=10 ⇒ S_B=10, S_A=20. So a+A=20, b+B=10. Use product eqns: aA=4bB and a(A−5)=b(B+5). Substitute A=20−a, B=10−b, solve integers a≤15, b≤10. Unique solution a=10, b=5. Product=50.
